captions.text: Graph mode draws documents as nodes and links as edges.
Clicking a node opens its document.
Related results follows the links out of the orders.
The territory's page shows the views its class declares.
The class generates the form, and Save writes the graph.
A file dropped on the document is uploaded into it.
The upload is picked as the value of a property.
The territory's view picks up the change by itself.
The breadcrumb leads back up to the container.
A SPARQL query is saved as a document.
Its results are rendered as a view.
A result set chart is bound to the query.
In Content mode the document is a list of blocks.
An XHTML block holds the prose.
An object block embeds the chart.
Dragging a block reorders the page.

slide.title: The application is data.
slide.lede: Classes, forms, views, charts and access rules are RDF documents. Push a folder of Turtle and the dataspace is live. An agent can write it.
